newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOCCER-THIRD DIVISION NIMES STUN HONVED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-THIRD DIVISION NIMES STUN HONVED.

text.p: Humble Nimes humiliated former Hungarian giants Kispest Honved by beating them 2-1 away and 5-2 on aggregate in their European Cup Winners' Cup first round on Thursday.
Nimes, in the tournament after losing the French cup final to league and cup double winners Auxerre, became only the second third division club to reach the second round in European competition.
They went ahead as early as the seventh minute when defender Johnny Ecker headed home a corner taken by captain Antoine Di Fraya.

Mounting dangerous counter-attacks against a Honved side often in disarray in the first half, Nimes went further ahead in the 38th minute when striker Eric Sabin volleyed a Di Fraya cross home off the underside of the bar.

Honved, 13 times Hungarian champions, restored some of their badly dented pride when Attila Piroska broke through the middle, rounded two defenders and scored with a low curling shot in the 61st minutef.
A minute earlier Mihaly Toth, who scored the Hungarians' only goal in Nimes, hit the post.
Hungarian hero Ferenc Puskas, said on French television: "These things happen in matches which you have already lost and which you want to win any old how and play badly.
"Before, Hungarian footballers were the gods of technique. This team (Nimes) can achieve something." 262117 GMT sep 96
